result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on what platform your store uses. If you're selling in Canada, there are a few particularly good options.

Here's how I'd rank them.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Straightforward setup
- Accepts credit and debit cards
- Apple Pay and Google Pay
- Recurring payments and subscriptions
- Excellent integrations

Canadian domestic online cards: approximately 2.9% + C\$0.30.

[Stripe Canada website](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify
- Easy checkout integration
- No separate payment processor setup
- Supports major cards and digital wallets

Processing fees depend on your Shopify subscription.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best as an additional option)

- Familiar and trusted by shoppers
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance
- Easy to integrate
- Useful for international customers

[PayPal Business Canada](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Helcim**

(Best for growing businesses)

- Canadian payment processor
- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly subscription
- Worth comparing as sales volume increases

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com/)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store in Canada\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments, with PayPal as an additional checkout option.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe, with PayPal as an additional option.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Growing store with substantial sales\:** Compare Helcim's pricing.

The biggest mistake is choosing a processor based only on its transaction percentage. Monthly fees, international transactions, currency conversion, refunds and chargebacks can make a significant difference. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hackceleration.com](https://www.hackceleration.com/labs/best/payment-gateway-ecommerce?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business.

I have three questions\:

1\. **What platform is your store using?**

- Shopify
- WooCommerce / WordPress
- Wix
- Squarespace
- Custom website
- Haven't built it yet

2\. **Where will you primarily sell?**

- Canada
- United States
- Canada and US
- Worldwide

3\. **Approximately how much do you expect to sell monthly?**

- Under \$1,000
- \$1,000–\$5,000
- \$5,000–\$20,000
- \$20,000+

With those answers, I can recommend the most cost-effective processor and estimate how much you'll actually pay in processing fees each month.
